assets.title: Fixed Indoor Table Football
assets.description: Original fixed indoor table-football assembly with four feet and legs, tied frame, supported recessed marked field, two real goal openings into local enclosed pockets, eight rods through sixteen bored side bearings, fixed locating collars, eight grips and twenty-two solid figures in opposed 1-2-5-3 team arrangements. Full reported dimensions include all grips and end pockets. Named editable static components at one centered pose only; no telescopic or continuous rod movement, playable ball physics, scoring, complete ball-return route, load or child-safety certification. Original floor selection and full actual foot support are verified separately.
